events_actor_names_user.name: events_actor_names_user
events_actor_names_user.value: "events"."actor_kind" NOT IN ('agent', 'web_session') OR ("events"."actor_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "events"."surface" IS NOT NULL)

events_operator_names_command.name: events_operator_names_command
events_operator_names_command.value: ("events"."actor_kind" = 'operator') = ("events"."operator_command" IS NOT NULL) AND ("events"."actor_kind" <> 'operator' OR ("events"."actor_user_id" IS NULL AND "events"."client" IS NULL AND "events"."surface" IS NULL AND "events"."team_id" IS NULL))

messages_actor_names_user.name: messages_actor_names_user
messages_actor_names_user.value: "messages"."actor_kind" NOT IN ('agent', 'web_session') OR ("messages"."actor_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "messages"."surface" IS NOT NULL)

packet_revisions_actor_names_user.name: packet_revisions_actor_names_user
packet_revisions_actor_names_user.value: "packet_revisions"."actor_kind" NOT IN ('agent', 'web_session') OR ("packet_revisions"."actor_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "packet_revisions"."surface" IS NOT NULL)

proposals_cancel_reason_known.name: proposals_cancel_reason_known
proposals_cancel_reason_known.value: ("proposals"."state" = 'cancelled') = ("proposals"."cancel_reason" IS NOT NULL) AND ("proposals"."cancel_reason" IS NULL OR "proposals"."cancel_reason" IN ('terminal_state', 'reassigned', 'accountable_removed', 'stale'))

requests_claimed_has_claimant.name: requests_claimed_has_claimant
requests_claimed_has_claimant.value: "requests"."state" NOT IN ('claimed', 'in_progress') OR "requests"."claimant_user_id" IS NOT NULL
